concerns.text: The plan’s testing matrix (Section “Phase 3 – Statistical Rigor”) references only `tests/unit/test_feature_matrix_schema.py` for CSV validation against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. The contract `contracts/features.schema.yaml` (MicrostateFeatureSchema) is defined but never exercised by any test or validation step in the plan, creating a mismatch between the contract set and the plan’s verification activities.
